about: What the retired Swift Mac app last wrote into a box's release (`"Kuvo Code" --write-box-files`, a build of commit 2fe5710a0, 2026-11-15, whose generators were main's when the box took the release over, #715): each file that isn't built from the box's sources or named for the version, by its SHA-256 and mode, for the engine named here. box/test/release-catalogs.test.ts holds what the box writes for that engine to it, so machines saw no change. When one of these files is changed on purpose in box/src, move its line out of `files` into `changed` (and `bin/.kuvo-boot`'s with a keeper file's): what's left still guards the rest.
